nodes.label: Things
nodes.rationale: Everything is a Thing in one logical things collection; folders are folder Things, and a child's folderId points to a same-account folder.

nodes.label: actionOutcome
nodes.rationale: Action outcomes retain safe effect receipts in the existing Timeline rather than introducing a new history store or growing array.

nodes.label: builder-thing schema
nodes.rationale: The Builder marker is additive metadata: it grants no access and does not choose a renderer.

nodes.label: History Browser
nodes.rationale: Combines shared history presentation, canonical cached record-derived labels and filters, and Timeline commands.

nodes.label: File Content Timeline Snapshots
nodes.rationale: Uses canonical byte versions as bound attachments.

nodes.label: Retained File History
nodes.rationale: Planner/checkpoint journals preserve ignored baseline entries so adding an exclusion cannot be mistaken for deletion.

nodes.label: Device Sync Ignore Rules
nodes.rationale: Older clients refuse nonempty ignore rules unless configuration version 2, api.things 1.38, and native file access 1.9 are available.

nodes.label: MobileSyncConnections
nodes.rationale: Saved confirmation appears only after the foreground retention run completes; the same editable connection Thing and foreground pipeline expose photo backup.

nodes.label: useApi().v1.files
nodes.rationale: Reads and commits through the existing files API with account, origin, and home fences.

nodes.label: getAttachmentDownload
nodes.rationale: Applies the existing permission gate to downloads.

nodes.label: SyncConflictReview
nodes.rationale: Capture leaves the conflict unresolved and the sync baseline unchanged.

nodes.label: ManagedFileStore
nodes.rationale: Schema 4 retains immutable blobs and atomic receipts for local recovery.

nodes.label: FolderBridge
nodes.rationale: Authenticates to the selected origin/account and gates source disclosure on current permission.

nodes.label: PhotoLibrary
nodes.rationale: Uses MediaStore for original-media backup.

nodes.label: PhotoDocumentsProvider
nodes.rationale: Provides read-only system-folder selection for original-media backup.

nodes.label: SystemPhotoResources
nodes.rationale: PhotoKit adapter for Apple photo originals.

nodes.label: MobileFolderStore
nodes.rationale: Stores a read-only source intent in the existing account/origin Keychain envelope.

nodes.label: MacFolderSyncDialogs
nodes.rationale: Handles explicit source selection and permission for Mac Photos.

nodes.label: MacFolderSync
nodes.rationale: Provides account-bound read-only grants and binary ranges.

nodes.label: fileUploadVersion
nodes.rationale: Connects FingerprintSource.uploadFile and cloudTransport.ts to NativeFileUploadJob; history remains in the shared Timeline.

nodes.label: Cloud Backup Capture
nodes.rationale: A prepared inventory alone does not hold a source version; only a verified completion seal proves independent bytes.

nodes.label: Password Migration Coverage and Encrypted File Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Every original 1PUX member remains an encrypted attachment to its source archive entry, while editors preserve structured values, source context, and password history.

nodes.label: Mac Backup Scan Implementation
nodes.rationale: The shared bounded Rust walker adapts observations into private JSONL, while sealing and reads remain gated by live authority.

nodes.label: NodeController
nodes.rationale: Carries transient identity failures into the existing retry scheduler.

nodes.label: SyncProgressViewer
nodes.rationale: Provides file-tree controls and editable sync progress blocks.

nodes.label: Device Sync and File Locations
nodes.rationale: The root library contains Things rather than setup/sync panels; virtual recovery files record that the original folder location is unknown and never fabricate a device path.

nodes.label: Device Activity Ownership
nodes.rationale: Background producers register with stable semantic IDs, return cleanup, and honor abort signals; the manager does not monkey-patch browser globals.

nodes.label: activityRequest
nodes.rationale: Only the trusted main renderer at its configured node origin may invoke the versioned desktop preload request.

nodes.label: Native Node service
nodes.rationale: Is a separately controlled owner; disabling persists intent before stopping launchd while preserving pairing, grants, and journals.

nodes.label: Referenced-by Parent Paths
nodes.rationale: An explicit, bounded reference scan covers accessible owner-library entries and viewable direct ancestors; it does not automatically sweep the home library.

nodes.label: fileAccessVersion
nodes.rationale: Adds optional selected-source absolute path metadata without granting access to ancestors; stale/unavailable bookmarks and Photos omit it.

nodes.label: deviceSyncControl
nodes.rationale: Uses existing mailbox ownership, leases, and immutable saves with negotiated API/native capability requirements.

nodes.label: DeviceSyncResources
nodes.rationale: Exposes editable live/history controls and stats.

nodes.label: fileDownloadVersion
nodes.rationale: Reports temporary transport failures as runnable waits; retries revalidate the same owner, origin, revision, and signed range before resuming retained staging offsets.

nodes.label: Files Browser and Sync Folder Publication
nodes.rationale: Moves and Trash use the selected Timeline revision and preserve original file IDs and history; the sync inventory enumerates only canonical files and folders.

nodes.label: Numeric Summaries
nodes.rationale: Returns only a complete maximum or null; aborts, pagination failures, and access failures never produce a partial maximum, and the read does not allocate an atomic sequence.

nodes.label: Exact Authorized Counts and Visible Offset Windows
nodes.rationale: Counts reflect authorized rows rather than loaded-page subtotals; offset windows avoid serial client fetching while preserving canonical authorization checks.

nodes.label: Ordered Exact-ID Joins
nodes.rationale: The existing read endpoint preserves requested ordering and duplicates while returning null for inaccessible or missing rows without exposing why.

nodes.label: Timeline Page Capture and Comparison Traversal
nodes.rationale: Capture and comparison share an iterative traversal that detects ancestor cycles without imposing block-count or nesting limits.

nodes.label: Builder App Entry Points and Scoped Navigation
nodes.rationale: Entry-point navigation opens an authorized live reader and preserves scoped browsing without executing Actions or changing audiences.

nodes.label: Reviewed Account Recovery Planning
nodes.rationale: Recovery plans are reviewed and sealed, with explicit unknown coverage and writer readiness; planning introduces no destination mutation endpoint.

nodes.label: Reviewed Ordinary Creation and Execution Holds
nodes.rationale: Execution is limited to explicitly selected closed private graphs and is resumable through receipts and checkpoints; durable write authority remains with canonical content transactions.
